styles.name: Bastion

openingTechnique.name: Entrenched
openingTechnique.description: Begin each battle with Barrier equal to 5% of Max Health.

styles.description: All healing received restores 25% as Health and converts 75% into Barrier.

refinements.name: Rebuild
refinements.description: Healing received below 35% Health restores its full amount directly as Health instead of converting part of it into barrier.

refinements.name: Reprisal
refinements.description: Store 25% of enemy damage absorbed by your Barrier, up to 10% of Max Health. Your next damaging Essence adds the stored amount to its first direct enemy attack attempt.

refinements.name: Shelter
refinements.description: Split converted Barrier equally with the ally with the lowest health percentage; retain it all when alone.

upgrades.name: Prepared Wall
upgrades.masteryDescription: You also gain this bonus when you have no Barrier.
upgrades.description: When you receive healing at 80% Health or higher, Fortification grants extra Barrier equal to 7.5% of the heal.

upgrades.name: Hold the Breach
upgrades.masteryDescription: That heal also restores 20% more Health.
upgrades.description: When you receive healing while having no Barrier, Fortification grants extra Barrier equal to 7.5% of the heal.

upgrades.name: Measured Recovery
upgrades.masteryDescription: Any overhealing is converted into Barrier.
upgrades.description: Fortification’s normal healing split restores 30% as Health, up from 25%.

styles.name: Conduit
styles.description: The first Essence in your Loadout is Channeled. Each other Essence grants 1 Charge when cast, up to a cap of 3 Charges. Your Channeled Essence consumes all Charges to boost its Damage, Healing, and Barrier.

refinements.name: Deep Reservoir
refinements.description: Charges now cap at 4. Your Channeled Essence starts at 60% strength and gains +25% per Charge spent.

refinements.name: Relay
refinements.description: Spending 2 or more Charges refunds 1 Charge. Your Channeled Essence starts at 80% strength and gains +15% per Charge spent.

upgrades.name: Full Circuit
upgrades.masteryDescription: This bonus now works whenever you spend 2 or more Charge.
upgrades.description: Spending maximum Charge adds a flat +5% to your Channeled Essence’s immediate damage, healing and Barrier.

upgrades.name: Partial Flow
upgrades.masteryDescription: This bonus now works with either 1 or 2 Charge.
upgrades.description: Spending exactly 1 Charge adds a flat +5% to your Channeled Essence’s immediate damage, healing and Barrier.

upgrades.name: Emergency Channel
upgrades.masteryDescription: You gain this bonus at any Health, as long as your Channeled Essence spends at least 1 Charge.
upgrades.description: When your Channeled Essence spends Charge at 35% Health or lower, add a flat +5% to the healing and Barrier it gives you immediately.

styles.name: Reaper
styles.description: When an active ability directly damages an enemy, consume the next tick of all current Bleed, Burn, and Poison stacks you applied to them, dealing 110% of that damage immediately.

openingTechnique.name: Grave Seed
openingTechnique.description: Innate: apply Poison(5) to the enemy with the highest Max Health.

refinements.name: Soul Siphon
refinements.description: Harvest now heals you instead of dealing damage.

refinements.name: Last Rites
refinements.description: Harvest only triggers when the target enemy is at 35% Health or less, and consumes all remaining ticks. Deep Roots has no effect.

refinements.name: Death Sentence
refinements.description: Harvest gains a flat +10% and applies its damage as Doom.

upgrades.name: Closing Hand
upgrades.description: Your Harvest gains a flat +5% when your opponent is at or below 35% Health
upgrades.masteryDescription: You now get this bonus at 50% enemy Health or less. Last Rites still only activates at 35% Health or less.

upgrades.name: Crosscut
upgrades.description: Your Harvest gains a flat +5% when it draws damage from at least two of Bleed, Burn and Poison.
upgrades.masteryDescription: Harvesting 3 or more stacks also gives you this bonus, even if they are all the same condition.

upgrades.name: Deep Roots
upgrades.description: Your Harvest gains a flat +5% if every stack you harvest still has damage left to deal afterwards. Has no effect with Last Rites.
upgrades.masteryDescription: Only one of the stacks you harvest needs to have damage left afterwards to get this bonus. Has no effect with Last Rites.

styles.name: Duelist
styles.description: Each basic attack or Essence cast that deals direct damage builds 1 Read. At 3 Read, your next damaging Essence consumes all Read to deal 145% direct damage to that opponent. Changing opponents resets Read.

openingTechnique.name: First Impression
openingTechnique.description: Your first successful attack against a surviving opponent grants 2 extra Read. The attack that prepares an Opening cannot spend it.

refinements.name: Flurry
refinements.description: Openings deal 130% damage and refund 1 Read against that opponent.

refinements.name: Patient Blade
refinements.description: Openings now require 5 Read and deal 180% damage.

refinements.name: Guarded Thrust
refinements.description: Openings deal 125% damage and grant Guard(1) after your cast.

upgrades.name: Measured Strikes
upgrades.description: Your Opening gains a flat +10% if you landed at least one basic attack against that opponent while preparing it.
upgrades.masteryDescription: Two or more successful basic attacks raise the bonus to a flat +20% instead. One basic attack still grants a flat +10%.

upgrades.name: Know Your Enemy
upgrades.description: After spending an Opening against an opponent, later Openings against them gain a flat +10% until you change opponents.
upgrades.masteryDescription: The flat +10% also applies to your first Opening against each opponent.

upgrades.name: Finishing Touch
upgrades.description: Your Opening gains a flat +10% when your opponent is at or below 35% Health before the strike.
upgrades.masteryDescription: The same bonus now applies at or below 50% Health.
